title: eval-harness: add prompt-set regression CI hook and quality gating
author: Maya Patel
description: Add a CI hook and quality-gating integration for the eval-harness to catch prompt-set regressions and enforce evaluation thresholds in the release pipeline. Motivation: several recent rollouts showed regressions that were only discovered post-release because evals were not automatically enforced in CI. This change wires the eval-harness into the GitHub Actions pipeline, introduces a lightweight gating config that can be checked per-PR, and provides a fail-fast mode that blocks merges if key eval metrics fall below configured baselines. Changes include: 1) a new GH Action job `eval-regression-check` that runs selected prompt-sets (smoke + critical) against the candidate model snapshot, 2) a JSON-based gating config (eval/config/gates.yaml) that maps prompt-sets to metric thresholds and severity, 3) a test-only stub harness mode for faster feedback in pre-submit CI, and 4) annotated reporting back to the PR with a summary, metric diffs, and links to the full eval artifacts stored in S3. Implementation notes: the GH action invokes `eval-harness run --snapshot $MODEL_SNAPSHOT --prompts critical,smoke --output artifacts/$PR_NUMBER`, with a new `--fail-on-gate` flag that exits non-zero when any gate is violated (configurable per-label). For Dedicated/Private pipelines the gate runner can be toggled off by the `skip-eval-gate` label to avoid costly runs during internal-only iterations. Testing performed: local harness smoke runs, end-to-end run in the release-candidate workflow, and synthetic regression tests added to eval-harness unit tests. Rollout plan: enable gate in strict mode for `release/*` branches on day 1, enable for `main` after 2 weeks. Backout plan: remove GH Action or set `fail-on-gate: false`. See release notes below for user-facing impact and action items.

diff_snippets:
.github/workflows/pull-request.yml:+  eval-regression-check:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
+      - name: Run eval-harness prompt regression check
+        run: scripts/ci/run_eval.sh --prompts critical,smoke --fail-on-gate

eval-harness/gates.py:+def check_gates(results, gates_config):
+    failures = []
+    for gate in gates_config:
+        metric = results.get(gate['metric'])
+        if metric is None or metric < gate['threshold']:
+            failures.append(gate['name'])
+    return failures

eval-harness/runner.py:+    if args.fail_on_gate and check_gates(eval_results, gates_config):
+        print('Eval gate violated; failing CI')
+        return 2
review_conversation: Lina Chen: Can we keep the critical prompt-set budgets shallow so the GH action finishes in under 12m?
Maya Patel: Yep — added a test-only stub mode and limited the default critical set to 15 prompts. Full runs are available in artifacts for manual review.
Omar Rodriguez: LGTM after minor naming nit and adding a feature flag for disabling fail-on-gate on internal branches.
Maya Patel: Addressed naming and added SKIP_EVAL_GATE env var and skip-eval-gate label handling.
Priya Natarajan: Approved — heavy thumbs up on guardrails for release pipeline.
release_notes: Add automatic prompt-set regression checks to CI and an opt-in quality gating mechanism. Release pipeline will now fail merges when configured eval thresholds are violated for critical prompt-sets. Admins can bypass using the skip-eval-gate label or SKIP_EVAL_GATE env var.
